selections.rationale: One bounded test-only correction; preserve r6 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Exercise integer and tuple batch mapping keys without coercion: each output key must retain its supplied identity/value and batch iteration order. Use a nonempty byte payload and require the specified descriptor under each key. Also combine one-shot record iterators with multiple schemes, duplicate scheme suppression, duplicate record replacement without position change, partial blocks and mutable payload isolation. Preserve ordinary malformed-record and unknown-scheme checks. Do not impose a string-only batch-key restriction or require an unpromised concrete input Mapping class.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r6 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Remove the assertion demanding an exception for locality=None on empty notices; the specification does not require that rejection. Remove other filter-type rejection assertions not grounded in the prompt's notice-field validation rules; do not replace them with a new universal filter policy. Add a matching notice exposed through standard MappingProxyType, containing the required string fields and published=True plus an ordinary nested dictionary/list; use an authenticated MappingProxyType principal too. Require the matching contents and verify deep ownership in both directions by mutating the returned nested value and the original backing nested value separately. Assert behavior, not a concrete type for copied mappings. Preserve authentication-first, all-notice scalar validation with correctly shaped fixtures, exact filtering, order, duplicates and nonmutation. Do not broaden requirements to arbitrary noncopyable descendants.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r6 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Use actual overflow-range finite integers such as 10**500 for ranks, with adjacent integer ranks and controlled title/ID tie breaks. Require exact descending rank order and preservation of values, without converting expected integers to floats or allocating large collections. Keep ordinary finite-float ranks, bool/nonfinite rejection, fuzzy and substring matching, category/enabled filtering, pagination and deep snapshots. The earlier 10**200 fixture alone is insufficient to exercise the integer range boundary. Do not add a rank cap, float-output requirement or global conversion-limit changes.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r6 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Add an attributes dictionary with an integer key and require TypeError under the declared dict[str, object] and wrong-type contract. Include valid empty-string and nonempty-string attribute keys with ordinary nested values; empty attribute keys are not prohibited. Preserve deep isolation, frozen dataclass shape/defaults, supported kinds, title/curator/tag trimming, blank and normalized duplicate rejection, exact output key order and tag order. Do not invent a nonempty attribute-key rule or require a different attributes container type.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r6 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Exercise the Zone lookup command itself with empty, space-only, tab-only and Unicode-trim blank U+2003 names; require Invalid and unchanged workshop state. Contrast a nonblank absent Zone name, which returns NotFound without mutation. Include a padded valid existing Zone lookup with the prescribed insertion-order IDs. Preserve command-built state, sorted Summary, trimmed names, duplicate/missing operations, tool/zone consistency, cascade removal and failed-command nonmutation. Do not substitute blank AddZone coverage for blank Zone queries or corrupt public state into an unspecified configuration.

One bounded test-only correction; preserve r6 specification/reference/mutant bytes unchanged. Remove U+000B vertical tab from the bracketed whitespace success assertion. Preserve independent success witnesses for HT U+0009, LF U+000A, CR U+000D and FF U+000C surrounding records and the entire bracket container, with expected sorted canonical rendering. In particular, place this permitted whitespace around individual records so record-padding behavior is exercised, not only outer-container padding. Do not assert either acceptance or rejection of vertical tab, expand ASCII padding into a universal Unicode policy, or change the specification. Retain malformed interior whitespace, Lines blank/CR rejection, percent-byte and UTF-8 errors, duplicate keys, canonical uppercase escapes, compact/noncompact rendering and empty cases. Use only explicitly promised public API traits.
